author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I don't believe in AGI.  Humans have souls and consciousness.  AI is just GPUs with lots of RAM.

I see the source code of the GPU, I can run simulation and emulation of it.  I can attest there is absolutely no souls and consciousness in GPUs, it is just waveforms in there.
